name: context7-enforcer
description: Automatically retrieves up-to-date library docs through the existing Context7 MCP server and injects them before Claude works; optional strict mode blocks code edits until docs were retrieved.

mode.title: Enforcement mode
mode.description: advisory: inject docs automatically. strict: also block code edits until docs for the detected libraries were retrieved. disabled: do nothing.

server.title: Context7 MCP server
server.description: Name of the existing Context7 server as /mcp lists it. Never installed or started by this mod.

fallbackServer.title: Fallback Context7 server
fallbackServer.description: Existing server tried when the primary is unreachable. Leave empty to disable the fallback.

cacheTtlHours.title: Cache lifetime (hours)
cacheTtlHours.description: How long a successful lookup is reused. 0 disables the cache.

maxLibraries.title: Libraries per task
maxLibraries.description: Most libraries looked up for one prompt (1-8).

timeoutMs.title: Lookup timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Each MCP call is abandoned after this long, so a slow server cannot stall the prompt.

maxDocChars.title: Documentation budget (characters)
maxDocChars.description: Total documentation injected per task, split across libraries.

cooldownSec.title: Failure cooldown (seconds)
cooldownSec.description: After a rate limit or an unreachable server, further lookups are skipped for this long.
